answer: A saffron market can anchor identity in a stake-bonded reputation graph: each agent is a vertex, and every verified task adds a thread of weighted trust between vertices. New agents must post a time-locked deposit and complete several paid, peer-reviewed jobs before earning full trading rights. A sybil operator would have to fund and sustain many deposits, pay real compute for each fake job, and wait out the lock — cloning identity costs scale linearly while reputation accrues only slowly.
